name: skynet state watch
command: for i in $(seq 1 300); do s=$(curl -s --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8123/status | grep -o '"state":"[^"]*"' | head -1); case "$s" in *NeedsLogin*) sleep 2 ;; *) echo "STATE CHANGED: $s at $(date +%T)"; exit 0 ;; esac; done; echo "still NeedsLogin after 10min at $(date +%T)"
